output_array_memory_estimate.formula: (q8_points+q10_points) * (7 complex128 3-vectors + points_nm float64 3-vector + weights float64 scalar) * endpoint_states
output_array_memory_estimate.scope_note: Conservative logical NumPy-array allowance for before/after field bundles; excludes solver objects, mesh/assembly temporary arrays and library caches; not observed RSS.

A1_q_attempt2.planning_envelope_basis: Rounded up from about 3x the actual same-q19/q32 A1_q1 sampled peak (9.04 GiB); the extra margin covers unmeasured full field/output overlap, backend growth and JIT/cache uncertainty. It is a planning envelope, not a measured RSS or hard cap.
A1_q_attempt2.nnz_semantics: operator matrix storage used/allocated from the prior R10 run summary; factor-matrix NNZ is separately recorded above and is not the same quantity
A1_q_attempt2.rss_uncertainty: Very high: prior A1_q1 ran the same q19/q32 settings and provides a 9.04 GiB observed sampled peak, but it terminated before complete endpoint output and does not calibrate the full retained-factor/output overlap. The 7.17 GiB value is the old q15/q28 R10 peak plus a logical-array allowance, not a q19/q32 measurement; use 32 GiB only as a conservative dispatch planning envelope, not a guarantee. READY requires a fresh dynamic cap; hard absolute cap is 192 GiB.
A1_q_attempt2.solved_rows_semantics: independent trace rows plus 612 DtN port rows; cell interiors locally eliminated/recovered
A1_q_attempt2.wall_planning: A1_q1 measured 4882.4474 s whole-watchdog on the same q19/q32 route but ended before complete endpoint output; treat this as an observed partial-workflow lower bound. The older q15/q28 R10 run was 2588.5174 s. Plan for 4882–7200 s with high uncertainty; 7200 s is a hard stop, never extended.

A2_q_attempt3.planning_envelope_basis: Rounded up from about 3x the 26.12 GiB historical process-tree peak plus logical output-array allowance; the extra margin covers unmeasured retained-factor/output overlap, backend growth and JIT/cache uncertainty. It is a planning envelope, not a measured RSS or hard cap.
A2_q_attempt3.nnz_semantics: native condensed operator matrix storage used/allocated from the prior Y6_1 summary; prior MUMPS INFOG values are not factor NNZ or process RSS
A2_q_attempt3.rss_uncertainty: Very high: 26.12 GiB is the prior whole-tree RSS plus a logical allowance for before/after sampled arrays. Prior route released the factor before p0 output; V3 deliberately overlaps the factor with primary modal/Av/field outputs. Use 96 GiB (about 3x the 26.12 GiB lower anchor, rounded upward) as a conservative dispatch planning envelope, not a measured peak. MUMPS INFOG 16/17 are solver-reported units, not process RSS. No measured V3 overlap exists; fresh dynamic gate and 192 GiB absolute cap govern.
A2_q_attempt3.solved_rows_semantics: 120960 active trace rows plus 612 port rows; interiors locally condensed/recovered
A2_q_attempt3.wall_planning: Historical native Y6 whole watchdog 1909.7389 s (not solver-internal 1905.8774 s). q19/q32 and factor-retained output change costs; planning anchor 1909–7200 s with high uncertainty and 7200 s hard stop, never extended.

prediction_limit: These are preflight planning estimates only. They do not establish physical qualification, measured resource use, or READY. Each actual dispatch requires fresh host/resource/source/input checks.
